instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Implementation must use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Maintain the non-negotiable aesthetic: Hand-drawn organic outlines (2px dark SVG stroke with slight wiggle filter), paper grain texture overlay, warm nostalgic 90s color palette.
Implement the quiet opening windowsill scene first with clickable journal that triggers scale/zoom motion into the game loop.
Ensure all 16 mini-games are forgiving, playful, touch-friendly, and mobile-first with no viewport scrolling issues.
Store progress, collected skills, XP balloons, and evidence cards in localStorage.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, mini-game targets, tabs, cards).
Follow WCAG AA contrast rules for text labels over hand-drawn backgrounds.
The archive must offer smooth switching between Backpack, Workroom case studies, and Trophy Shelf.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark gradients; use flat organic colors with subtle grain textures.
Ensure mobile responsiveness (mobile-first layout with max-h-[80vh] for game panels).
Avoid generic centered layouts or corporate templates. Embrace asymmetry and hand-crafted feel.
All interactive elements MUST have explicit hover, focus, and active states with custom cursor pointers.
